reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about Ni-induced melting, wetting, void filling, and property enhancement, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific behaviour of Ni in W–Cu SPS, so the lack of citations leaves all key premises unsupported.
